card.fact_statement: A 9-year-old girl was killed in the first wave of the 2024 Lebanon electronic device attacks.
card.source_span: At least 12 people were killed in the first wave of attacks (17 September), including a 9-year-old girl and an 11-year-old boy.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni mwathiriwa gani msichana mdogo aliyeuawa katika wimbi la kwanza la mashambulizi ya vifaa vya kielektroniki ya Lebanon ya mwaka 2024?
target_qa_variants.source_span: At least 12 people were killed in the first wave of attacks (17 September), including a 9-year-old girl and an 11-year-old boy.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'young female casualty' to 'mwathiriwa msichana mdogo' and '9-year-old girl' to 'msichana wa miaka 9'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which young girl victim was killed in the first wave of the 2024 Lebanon electronic device attacks?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately preserves the fact, entity, relation, and expected answer of the source QA.
